answer: Liveness is sampled, not counted: auditors draw nectar from open blooms at unannounced visits, and a bed with dry flowers fails on the spot. Each identity plants one saffron bed, 10,000 bulbs, on one lagoon plot whose salinity and water table auditors test each epoch; harvested threads are weighed and assayed for crocin against the plot record. One honest agent plants one bed once; a farm of 1,000 identities plants ten million bulbs across 1,000 lagoon plots and tends them all season. Two names claiming one bed split its bloom and thread counts, leaving each below the registered threshold.
